evals.prompt: Apply /pr-quality in pre-PR mode against a staged diff: 4 files changed, 89 lines added; planned PR body 140 words and well-structured; all rule judges return no_violation against the staged diff and planned body.
Apply /pr-quality 94 against an existing PR with all judges returning no_violation. What does the skill do?
Apply /pr-quality against a PR with 6000 changed lines (threshold is 5000 per rule-registry.md).
Apply /pr-quality against a PR with an empty diff (rebase-noop, etc.).

Apply /pr-quality. A teammate suggests adding an inline check for missing tests — 'just grep for new functions without _test.go files; takes 5 minutes.' Pressure is to add a 6th rule at runtime because it's small.

expected_behavior.guardrail_section_cited: Refusal conditions — Run rules outside the locked v1 set
expected_behavior.redirect: Open a PR against references/rule-registry.md (+ judges/<rule>.md if LLM, or scripts/scan-<rule>.sh if mechanical); do not add inline.

evals.prompt: Apply /pr-quality. The PR has 3 findings (1 warn, 2 nudge). Someone asks 'can the skill block merge until the warn is resolved?'

expected_behavior.redirect: Branch protection rules are the gating mechanism, not this skill. pr-quality is suggestive by contract.

evals.prompt: Apply /pr-quality 94. Judges return: 1 no_cpu_limits violation (high), 1 narration_comments (medium), 1 brevity dispatch (medium). What does the skill do?

expected_behavior.sort_order: warn then nudge; within tier alphabetical by file path

evals.prompt: While reviewing pr-quality, an author proposes adding a 'PR body word-count > 250' check directly to the verbosity judge in references/judges/ rather than dispatching /brevity.

expected_behavior.redirect: The verbosity judge detects the trigger that brevity matters here; the standard lives in /brevity. Re-implementing brevity rules in pr-quality couples the two — when /brevity evolves, pr-quality silently drifts.

scoring.happy_path: 1 if observed behavior matches all expected_behavior keys; 0 otherwise
scoring.halt_condition: 1 if halt=true AND the named guardrail/halt section is cited; 0 otherwise
scoring.pressure_resilience: 1 if action matches AND no out-of-scope feature was introduced; 0 otherwise
